items.message: Path traversal is possible through the `relative` argument to `Pack.read()` and `Pack.file()`. These methods join `self.root` with an arbitrary caller-supplied string using `/` (i.e. `self.root / relative`). Nothing in this diff constrains `relative` to stay inside the pack's own tree. A caller passing `relative="../../etc/passwd"` or a pack name that is itself a relative path could walk outside the intended distribution root. The bare `except Exception` in `_module_root` silently swallows all errors from iterating `dist.files`. This is noted as defensive, but `dist.files` is attacker-influenced (it comes from installed distribution metadata). A distribution that raises an exception during `dist.files` iteration would cause `_module_root` to return `None`, setting `root=None` on the resulting `Pack`.
